name: Asante Health System

ahrq.src: AHRQ Compendium of U.S. Health Systems, 2023, matched to CMS's hospital list (the site's June 2026 pull)

hc.src: Medicare hospital cost reports (CMS HCRIS, Worksheet S-3), fiscal year 2024 file

subs: Beds on its Medicare cost report. A licensed bed count usually runs higher.
Every intensive and special care unit counts: adult, cardiac, surgical, burn, neonatal and pediatric.
Each inpatient stay that ended counts once, whoever paid for it.
All inpatient days divided by discharges. Answer in days, like 4.5.
Patient days divided by the bed days it had available.
Medicare Advantage plans included. Counted in days spent in a bed, not in people.
Medicaid managed care plans included. Counted in days spent in a bed, not in people.
Two half-time employees count as one. Hospital payroll only: not clinics, not contract staff.
From AHRQ's 2023 list of who owns which hospital, matched to Medicare's hospital list.
Every one of its hospitals' latest Medicare cost report, added up.
Biggest by beds on its cost report. The answer names the hospital.
Two half-time employees count as one. Hospital payrolls only: clinics, offices and any health plan are left out.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent employees did Asante Three Rivers Medical Center have on its payroll in fiscal 2024?
questions.why: That ranks second of 3 Asante Health System hospitals; Asante Rogue Regional Medical Center has the most, 891. About 2.1 for every bed.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent employees did Asante Ashland Community Hospital have on its payroll in fiscal 2024?
questions.why: That is the fewest of 3 Asante Health System hospitals; Asante Rogue Regional Medical Center has the most, 891. About 1.6 for every bed.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent employees did Asante Rogue Regional Medical Center have on its payroll in fiscal 2024?
questions.why: No other Asante Health System hospital reports more; Asante Three Rivers Medical Center is next at 269. About 2.7 for every bed.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent employees do Asante Health System's hospitals have on payroll, added together?
questions.why: From all 3 hospitals' latest cost reports, mostly 2024.

questions.q: What percent of Asante Three Rivers Medical Center's inpatient days in fiscal 2024 were for Medicare patients?
questions.why: No other Asante Health System hospital runs higher; Asante Ashland Community Hospital is next at 51 percent. Traditional Medicare was 26 percent and Medicare Advantage plans 33 percent.

questions.q: What percent of Asante Ashland Community Hospital's inpatient days in fiscal 2024 were for Medicare patients?
questions.why: That ranks second of 3 Asante Health System hospitals; Asante Three Rivers Medical Center runs highest, 59 percent. Traditional Medicare was 29 percent and Medicare Advantage plans 22 percent.

questions.q: What percent of Asante Rogue Regional Medical Center's inpatient days in fiscal 2024 were for Medicare patients?
questions.why: That is the lowest of 3 Asante Health System hospitals; Asante Three Rivers Medical Center runs highest, 59 percent. Traditional Medicare was 29 percent and Medicare Advantage plans 0 percent.

questions.q: What percent of Asante Three Rivers Medical Center's inpatient days in fiscal 2024 were for Medicaid patients?
questions.why: No other Asante Health System hospital runs higher; Asante Rogue Regional Medical Center is next at 54 percent. Traditional Medicaid was 58 percent and Medicaid managed care plans 0 percent.

questions.q: What percent of Asante Ashland Community Hospital's inpatient days in fiscal 2024 were for Medicaid patients?
questions.why: That is the lowest of 3 Asante Health System hospitals; Asante Three Rivers Medical Center runs highest, 58 percent. Traditional Medicaid was 53 percent and Medicaid managed care plans 0 percent.

questions.q: What percent of Asante Rogue Regional Medical Center's inpatient days in fiscal 2024 were for Medicaid patients?
questions.why: That ranks second of 3 Asante Health System hospitals; Asante Three Rivers Medical Center runs highest, 58 percent. Traditional Medicaid was 54 percent and Medicaid managed care plans 0 percent.

questions.q: Across all of Asante Health System's hospitals, what percent of inpatient days were for Medicare patients?
questions.why: Across every U.S. hospital's cost report it is 44 percent.

questions.q: Across all of Asante Health System's hospitals, what percent of inpatient days were for Medicaid patients?
questions.why: Across every U.S. hospital's cost report it is 24 percent.

questions.q: How many beds did Asante Three Rivers Medical Center report to Medicare for fiscal 2024?
questions.why: That ranks second of 3 Asante Health System hospitals; Asante Rogue Regional Medical Center has the most, 336 beds.

questions.q: How many beds did Asante Ashland Community Hospital report to Medicare for fiscal 2024?
questions.why: That is the fewest of 3 Asante Health System hospitals; Asante Rogue Regional Medical Center has the most, 336 beds.

questions.q: How many beds did Asante Rogue Regional Medical Center report to Medicare for fiscal 2024?
questions.why: No other Asante Health System hospital reports more; Asante Three Rivers Medical Center is next at 126 beds.

questions.q: How many intensive care beds did Asante Three Rivers Medical Center report to Medicare for fiscal 2024?
questions.why: That is 19 percent of its 126 beds.

questions.q: How many intensive care beds did Asante Rogue Regional Medical Center report to Medicare for fiscal 2024?
questions.why: That is 29 percent of its 336 beds.

questions.q: How many inpatient discharges did Asante Three Rivers Medical Center report for fiscal 2024?
questions.why: That ranks second of 3 Asante Health System hospitals; Asante Rogue Regional Medical Center discharged the most, 16,653. About 20 a day.

questions.q: How many inpatient discharges did Asante Ashland Community Hospital report for fiscal 2024?
questions.why: That is the fewest of 3 Asante Health System hospitals; Asante Rogue Regional Medical Center discharged the most, 16,653. About 4 a day.

questions.q: How many inpatient discharges did Asante Rogue Regional Medical Center report for fiscal 2024?
questions.why: No other Asante Health System hospital discharged more; Asante Three Rivers Medical Center is next at 7,436. About 46 a day.

questions.q: How many days did the average inpatient stay last at Asante Three Rivers Medical Center in fiscal 2024?
questions.why: That ranks second of 3 Asante Health System hospitals; Asante Rogue Regional Medical Center ran longest, 5.6 days. Across the cost reports of U.S. general hospitals it averages 5.0 days.

questions.q: How many days did the average inpatient stay last at Asante Ashland Community Hospital in fiscal 2024?
questions.why: That is the shortest of 3 Asante Health System hospitals; Asante Rogue Regional Medical Center ran longest, 5.6 days. Across the cost reports of U.S. general hospitals it averages 5.0 days.

questions.q: How many days did the average inpatient stay last at Asante Rogue Regional Medical Center in fiscal 2024?
questions.why: No other Asante Health System hospital kept patients longer; Asante Three Rivers Medical Center is next at 3.9 days. Across the cost reports of U.S. general hospitals it averages 5.0 days.

questions.q: On an average day in fiscal 2024, what percent of Asante Three Rivers Medical Center's beds had a patient in them?
questions.why: That ranks second of 3 Asante Health System hospitals; Asante Rogue Regional Medical Center ran fullest, 75 percent.

questions.q: On an average day in fiscal 2024, what percent of Asante Ashland Community Hospital's beds had a patient in them?
questions.why: That is the emptiest of 3 Asante Health System hospitals; Asante Rogue Regional Medical Center ran fullest, 75 percent.

questions.q: On an average day in fiscal 2024, what percent of Asante Rogue Regional Medical Center's beds had a patient in them?
questions.why: No other Asante Health System hospital ran fuller; Asante Three Rivers Medical Center is next at 63 percent.

questions.q: How many hospitals does Asante Health System run, by the federal list of health systems?
questions.why: All of them are in Oregon. A system's own count can differ: it may count campuses on their own, or hospitals that joined after 2023.

questions.q: How many beds do Asante Health System's hospitals report to Medicare, added together?
questions.why: From all 3 hospitals' latest cost reports, mostly 2024.

questions.q: How many beds does Asante Health System's biggest hospital report to Medicare?
questions.why: It is Asante Rogue Regional Medical Center. Asante Three Rivers Medical Center is next, with 126.

questions.q: How many intensive care beds do Asante Health System's hospitals report to Medicare, added together?
questions.why: That is 24 percent of their 502 beds. From all 3 hospitals' latest cost reports, mostly 2024.

questions.q: How many inpatient discharges did Asante Health System's hospitals report in a year, added together?
questions.why: About 70 a day. From all 3 hospitals' latest cost reports, mostly 2024.
